blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The rapid progress of generative artificial intelligence has led to a significant increase in manipulated multimedia content, including synthetic faces, forged videos, AI-generated images, fake audio, and locally edited images. Existing detection approaches are typically designed for a single manipulation type, limiting their applicability in real-world scenarios involving heterogeneous media sources. In this work, we present the Media Intelligence Platform (MIP), a unified web-based framework for multimodal media forensics integrating specialized modules for fake video detection, face morphing detection, AI-generated image detection, audio deepfake detection, localized image manipulation detection, and text analysis. Its modular architecture enables flexible integration of heterogeneous models and supports future extensions for emerging manipulation techniques. Experimental results on representative benchmark datasets demonstrate reliable detection performance across multiple media modalities while providing a practical and user-friendly interface for forensic investigations. The platform highlights the potential of unified multimodal systems for comprehensive deepfake detection in real-world environments, and is accompanied by a public demonstrator released with this workshop submission to support reproducibility and community evaluation.
blocks.zh: 基因人工智能的快速进步导致被操纵的多媒体内容显著增加,包括合成面孔,伪造视频,AI生成的图像,假音频,以及当地编辑的图像. 现有检测方法一般是为单一的操纵类型设计的,限制其适用于涉及不同媒体来源的实际情况。 在这项工作中,我们介绍了媒体智能平台(MIP),这是一个统一的基于网络的多媒体法证框架,整合了用于假视频检测,面部变形检测,AI生成的图像检测,音频深假检测,局部图像操纵检测,以及文本分析的专门模块. 其模块化架构能够灵活地整合各种模型,并支持未来对新兴操纵技术的扩展. 具有代表性的基准数据集的实验结果表明,在提供实用和方便用户的法证调查界面的同时,各种媒体模式的可靠检测业绩。 该平台强调了统一多式联运系统在现实环境中全面检测深层假象的潜力,并配有公开演示人发布本讲习班材料,以支持可复制性和社区评价。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent advances in generative artificial intelligence (AI) have significantly increased the realism and accessibility of synthetic media, including manipulated or fully generated images, videos, audio, and text. Powered by diffusion models and generative adversarial networks (GANs), such content can often be indistinguishable from authentic media, creating new challenges for trust, security, and privacy.
blocks.zh: 最近基因人工智能(AI)的进步大大增加了合成媒介的现实主义和可获取性,包括被操纵或完全生成的图像、视频、音频和文本。 在传播模式和基因对抗网络的推动下,这些内容往往与真实媒体无法区分,给信任、安全和隐私带来了新的挑战。

blocks.en: While these technologies offer creative and practical benefits, they also enable malicious applications such as disinformation, identity fraud, deepfake pornography, and harmful online content. The rapid spread of synthetic media on social platforms has highlighted the growing need for reliable and scalable detection systems.
blocks.zh: 虽然这些技术提供了创造性和实用性的好处,但它们也促成了恶意应用,如虚假信息、身份欺诈、深层假色情和有害的在线内容。 合成媒体在社交平台上的迅速传播突出表明,越来越需要可靠和可扩展的检测系统。

blocks.en: In response, the media forensics community has developed a wide range of specialized detectors. However, most existing approaches focus on a single manipulation type or media modality, often rely on dataset-specific training, and frequently lack transparency or practical deployment support. This limits their applicability in real-world forensic and verification scenarios.
blocks.zh: 作为回应,媒体鉴证界开发了广泛的专业探测器. 然而,大多数现行办法都侧重于单一的操纵类型或媒体模式,往往依赖数据集特定培训,而且往往缺乏透明度或实际部署支助。 这限制了它们在现实世界的法医和核查情景中的适用性。

blocks.en: To address these limitations, we present the Media Intelligence Platform (MIP) , a unified web-based framework for multimodal media forensics. MIP integrates specialized modules for AI-generated image detection, image forgery localization, face morphing detection, deepfake video detection, audio deepfake detection, and text-based harmful content analysis. Its modular microservice architecture allows independent development and scalable deployment of heterogeneous forensic models while maintaining a consistent interface for users and external applications.
blocks.zh: 为解决这些局限性,我们介绍了媒体情报平台,这是一个统一的多媒体法证网络框架。 MIP整合了AI生成的图像检测,图像伪造本地化,面部形态检测,深假视频检测,音频深假检测,文本有害内容分析等专业模块. 其模块化的微服务架构允许独立开发和可扩展部署各种法证模型,同时为用户和外部应用保持一致的界面.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : MIP overview. The platform supports multimodal input upload, analysis tool selection, and job history tracking.
blocks.zh: 图1:中期计划概览。 平台支持多模式输入上传,分析工具选择,以及工作历史跟踪.

blocks.en: The platform provides both a user-friendly web interface and API access for practical use in forensic investigations, media verification, and trust-and-safety applications. Experimental evaluations on representative benchmark datasets demonstrate reliable performance across all supported modalities. Fig. 1 and Fig. 2 illustrate the MIP interface and result visualization workflow.
blocks.zh: 该平台提供方便用户的网络界面和API访问,用于法医调查、媒体核查以及信任和安全应用。 对代表性基准数据集的实验评价表明,在所有得到支持的模式中都取得了可靠的业绩。 图1和图2说明了MIP接口和结果可视化工作流程.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Example result view showing model predictions and explainable outputs.
blocks.zh: 图2:显示模型预测和可解释产出的示例结果视图。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Multimodal Detection Systems
blocks.zh: 2.1 多式联运探测系统

blocks.en: Recent work has increasingly moved beyond single-modality detectors toward integrated verification platforms that combine multiple forensic models across images, videos, audio, and text. Browser-based systems such as InVID-WeVerify and the vera.ai Verification Plugin provide unified interfaces for media upload, URL analysis, and credibility assessment [ 76 , 48 ] . Similarly, DeepFake-O-Meter v2.0 [ 32 ] aggregates multiple independent detectors for deepfake images, videos, and audio within a common online platform. Commercial systems such as TrueMedia [ 75 ] , Sensity [ 67 ] , and Reality Defender [ 63 ] extend this idea with API-based services for content moderation and fraud prevention. These systems demonstrate the growing relevance of multimodal media verification, but often suffer from limited transparency, restricted deployment options, and closed evaluation protocols.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作已日益超越单一模式探测器,转向综合核查平台,将跨图像、视频、音频和文本的多种法证模型结合起来。 基于浏览器的系统如InVID-WeVerify和vera.ai验证插件为媒体上传,URL分析和可信度评估提供了统一的接口[76,48]. 同样,DeepFake-O-Meter v2.0[32]在共同的在线平台内聚合了多个用于深假图像,视频,音频的独立探测器. TrueMedia[75]、Sensity[67]和Reality Defense[63]等商业系统将这一想法与基于API的服务相延伸,以达到内容节制和预防欺诈的目的。 这些系统表明,多式联运媒体核查的实用性日益提高,但往往受到透明度有限、部署选择有限和封闭的评价协议的影响。

blocks.en: 2.2 AI-Generated Image Detection
blocks.zh: 2.2 人工智能图像检测

blocks.en: Detection of AI-generated images has evolved from artifact-based methods toward more generalizable deep learning approaches. Existing methods exploit semantic inconsistencies, spatial artifacts, or generator-specific fingerprints [ 6 , 86 , 26 ] . More recent work has shifted toward diffusion-generated images, which exhibit fewer visible artifacts and challenge traditional GAN-oriented detectors [ 12 ] . Explainable AI (XAI) methods such as Grad-CAM [ 66 ] and SHAP [ 42 ] are increasingly integrated to improve transparency and support human verification.
blocks.zh: 对人工智能生成的图像的探测已经从基于文物的方法演变为更普遍的深入学习方法。 现有方法利用语义不一致,空间文物,或生成器专用指纹[6,86,26]. 最近的工作已转向传播生成的图像,这些图像显示的可见文物较少,并对传统的面向GAN的探测器提出了挑战[12]. Grad-CAM[66]和SHAP[42]等解释性的AI(XAI)方法日益融合,以提高透明度和支持人类核查。

blocks.en: 2.3 Image Forgery Detection and Localization
blocks.zh: 2.3 图像伪造检测和本地化

blocks.en: Image forgery detection and localization focuses on identifying manipulated regions in otherwise authentic images. Traditional methods addressed specific manipulation types such as splicing [ 44 ] , copy-move [ 38 ] , and inpainting [ 37 ] using handcrafted forensic traces. Recent work (for an overview see [ 51 ] ) increasingly relies on deep encoder–decoder architectures such as ManTra-Net [ 80 ] and U-Net variants [ 24 ] , enabling joint detection and localization of manipulated content. These approaches provide both binary authenticity decisions and pixel-level localization maps.
blocks.zh: 图像伪造检测和本地化的重点是在原本真实的图像中识别被操纵的区域. 传统方法涉及具体的操纵类型,例如:捣片[44]、复制-移动[38]、使用手工制作的法证痕迹涂漆[37]。 最近的工作(概览见[51])越来越依赖于深编码器-解码器架构,如ManTra-Net[80]和U-Net变体[24],从而可以对被操纵的内容进行联合检测和本地化. 这些方法既提供了二进制真实性决定,也提供了像素级本地化地图.

blocks.en: 2.4 Face Morphing Attack Detection
blocks.zh: 2.4 面部翻印攻击检测

blocks.en: Face morphing attack detection is typically divided into single-image (S-MAD) and differential (D-MAD) settings [ 4 ] . Recent methods increasingly rely on deep learning, replacing handcrafted features with discriminative embedding models. In S-MAD, self-supervised and metric-learning-based approaches have shown strong performance [ 30 , 73 ] , while D-MAD commonly employs Siamese architectures to compare probe and reference images [ 69 ] .
blocks.zh: 面部形态攻击探测一般分为单像(S-MAD)和差分(D-MAD)设置[4]. 最近的方法越来越依赖深入的学习,用歧视性嵌入模型取代手工制作的特征。 在S-MAD中,自我监督和以衡量学习为基础的方法表现出了良好的业绩[30,73],而D-MAD通常采用 暹罗建筑 比较探测和参考图像 [69].

blocks.en: 2.5 Audio Deepfake Detection
blocks.zh: 2.5 音频深假检测

blocks.en: Audio deepfake detection can be divided into speech deepfake detection (DSD) and environmental sound deepfake detection (DESD). Recent methods increasingly leverage large pre-trained audio foundation models such as XLSR [ 53 ] , WavLM [ 8 ] , and BEATs [ 9 ] , which are fine-tuned for downstream detection tasks. This transfer-learning paradigm has become dominant, consistently outperforming earlier handcrafted and task-specific approaches.
blocks.zh: 音频深假检测可分为语音深假检测(DSD)和环境声深假检测(DESD). 近代方法日益利用XLSR[53],WavLM[8],BEATs[9]等大型预训音频基础模型,为下游检测任务进行微调. 这种转让学习模式已变得占主导地位,一贯表现优于早先手工制作和针对具体任务的办法。

blocks.en: 2.6 Text-Based Detection
blocks.zh: 2.6 基于文本的检测

blocks.en: Text-based disinformation detection increasingly combines automated classification with explainability and interactive analysis. Existing work addresses tasks such as fact-checking, propaganda detection, sentiment analysis, and rumor detection [ 68 , 49 ] . More recent approaches integrate linguistic, semantic, and stylistic features to improve interpretability and robustness [ 34 , 36 ] . However, most systems remain limited to isolated tasks, motivating modular architectures that combine multiple text classifiers for toxicity, hate speech, and credibility assessment. Particularly relevant to online content moderation are toxicity and hate-speech detection systems, which identify abusive, offensive, or harmful language and are increasingly deployed as building blocks within larger trust-and-safety frameworks.
blocks.zh: 基于文字的假象探测日益将自动化分类与可解释性和交互式分析结合起来。 现有工作涉及事实检查、宣传检测、情绪分析和传闻检测等任务[68、49]。 较新的方法融合了语言、语义和语法特点,以提高可解释性和稳健性[34、36]。 然而,大多数系统仍然局限于孤立的任务,推动将多个文本分类器结合到毒性、仇恨言论和可信度评估的模块架构。 毒性和仇恨言论侦测系统与网上内容节制特别相关,这些系统查明了滥用、攻击或有害的语言,并越来越多地作为更大的信任和安全框架内的组成部分。

blocks.en: 3 System Architecture and Integration Framework
blocks.zh: 3 系统结构和综合框架

blocks.en: The Media Intelligence Platform (MIP) is a modular, container-based framework for multimodal content analysis that exposes forensic and AI-based analysis components through a unified REST interface. The platform supports image and video forensics, audio analysis, and text classification, while remaining extensible to future modalities and detection methods. Each analysis component is independently developed and deployed as a microservice, allowing the platform to scale without modifying the surrounding infrastructure. The complete system runs on an on-premises Kubernetes cluster and provides a reference web frontend (MIP-UI) for user interaction and access management.
blocks.zh: 媒体智能平台(MIP)是一个模块化,基于容器的多模式内容分析框架,通过统一的REST接口暴露出法证和AI分析组件. 该平台支持图像和视频法证,音频分析和文本分类,同时仍可延伸至未来模式和检测方法. 每个分析组件都是作为微服务独立开发并部署的,使得该平台可以在不修改周边基础设施的情况下进行规模化. 完整的系统运行在一个premise Kubernetes集群上,并为用户互动和访问管理提供参考网络前端(MIP-UI).

blocks.en: Fig. 3 illustrates the overall architecture of MIP. We distinguish between Modules and Models . A Module represents a specific analysis task (e.g. AI-generated image detection or text classification), while a Model is the underlying neural network implementing the task. A single Module may encapsulate multiple Models behind a common interface, enabling interchangeable inference without exposing internal implementation details.
blocks.zh: 图3说明了中期计划的总体结构。 我们区分模块和模型。 一个模块代表一个具体的分析任务(例如AI生成的图像检测或文本分类),而一个模型则是执行任务的基础神经网络. 一个单一模块可以将多个模型封装在一个共同界面之后,从而能够在不披露内部实施细节的情况下进行可互换的推论。

blocks.en: Each Module provides a standardized REST API for inference, status reporting, and result retrieval. Inputs can be uploaded directly or referenced via shared storage. Results are returned through a common ModuleResult schema, allowing uniform storage and processing across all modules. Every Module is packaged as an isolated Docker container and can optionally provide custom UI components for configuration and result visualization.
blocks.zh: 每个模块都提供了用于推断、状况报告和结果检索的标准化REST API。 输入可以通过共享存储直接上传或引用. 通过一个通用的模块Result计划返回结果,允许在所有模块中统一存储和处理。 每个模块被包装为一个孤立的Docker容器,可以选择提供自定义的UI组件用于配置和结果可视化.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Schematic of the MIP microservice architecture. Modules are deployed as Kubernetes pods and communicate via standardized REST APIs. Results and metadata are stored through a shared NFS file system and PostgreSQL backend.
blocks.zh: 图3:MIP微服务架构的表征. 模块作为Kubernetes舱部署,并通过标准化的REST API进行通信. 结果和元数据通过共享的NFS文件系统和PostgreSQL后端存储.

blocks.en: The microservice API is frontend-agnostic and allows arbitrary external applications to connect to the platform. We provide MIP-UI (Fig. 4 ) as a reference frontend, which implements user management, role-based access control, and job tracking. The frontend dynamically lists connected Modules, renders their configuration forms, and displays module-specific result visualizations. Through its /modules endpoint, MIP-UI also allows external partners to build custom interfaces on top of the platform.
blocks.zh: microservice API是前端不可知的,允许任意的外部应用程序连接到平台. 我们提供MIP-UI(图4)作为参考前端,它执行用户管理、基于角色的接入控制和工作跟踪。 前端动态列出连接模块,使其配置形式,并显示模块特定结果可视化. MIP-UI通过它的/modules端点,也允许外部合作伙伴在平台上方建立自定义接口.

blocks.en: Figure 4 : MIP-UI: reference frontend for module selection, job history, and result visualization.
blocks.zh: 图4 MIP-UI:模块选择、工作历史和结果可视化的参考前端。

blocks.en: MIP is deployed on on-premises hardware using Kubernetes and Helm-based infrastructure-as-code. The production system runs on multi-GPU hardware, while a separate development system supports internal testing. All services operate offline, which is essential for privacy-sensitive forensic workflows.
blocks.zh: MIP是使用Kubernetes和基于Helm的基础设施(即时代码)在前提硬件上部署的。 生产系统运行在多GPU硬件上,而单独的开发系统支持内部测试. 所有服务都离线运行,这对于注重隐私的法医工作流程至关重要。

blocks.en: To maximize hardware utilization, GPU resources are shared across multiple Modules using HAMi (Heterogeneous AI Computing Virtualization Middleware), enabling multiple inference services to run concurrently on a single GPU while maintaining memory isolation and fault containment.
blocks.zh: 为了最大限度地利用硬件,GPU资源通过多个模块共享,使用HAMI(异质AI计算虚拟化中件),使多个推论服务能够同时运行在一个单一的GPU上,同时保持内存隔离和断层封隔.

blocks.en: The platform follows four core design principles: modularity , extensibility , reproducibility , and deployment independence . These principles allow new detection modules to be integrated with minimal effort and ensure that the platform can evolve alongside emerging synthetic media threats.
blocks.zh: 平台遵循四个核心设计原则:模块性、可扩展性、可复制性和部署独立性。 这些原则使得新的检测模块能够以最小的努力进行整合,并确保该平台能够与新出现的合成媒体威胁一起发展。

blocks.en: 4 Visual Media Analysis Modules
blocks.zh: 4个视觉媒体分析单元

blocks.en: 4.1 AI-Generated Image Detection
blocks.zh: 4.1 人工智能图像检测

blocks.en: The increasing realism of text-to-image generation models has created a growing demand for reliable AI-generated image detection. In particular, passive forensic detectors are essential when proactive methods such as watermarking are absent or can be circumvented [ 85 , 71 ] .
blocks.zh: 文本到图像生成模型越来越现实化,产生了对可靠的AI生成图像检测的日益增长的需求. 特别是在没有诸如水印等主动方法或可以绕过这些方法时,被动法医探测器是必不可少的。

blocks.en: Within MIP, the AI-generated image detection module integrates four detector variants and 16 XAI methods. The module accepts standard image formats and allows users to compare predictions across multiple models while selecting different XAI strategies for visual interpretation of the decision process.
blocks.zh: 在MIP内部,AI生成的图像检测模块融合了4个探测器变体和16个XAI方法. 该模块接受标准图像格式,允许用户比较多个模型的预测,同时选择不同的XAI策略对决策过程进行视觉解释.

blocks.en: To improve robustness and generalization, we combine two architectural families: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs), both of which have shown strong performance for AI-image detection [ 87 , 17 ] . Specifically, the module integrates ResNet-50 [ 28 ] and ViT-B-16 [ 20 ] backbones with different fine-tuning strategies. While the ViT model is fully fine-tuned, the ResNet variants adapt progressively deeper layers.
blocks.zh: 为了提高活力和普及性,我们把两个建筑家庭结合起来: 革命神经网络(CNNs)和视觉变形器(ViTs),两者在AI-image探测[87,17]上都表现出强大的性能. 具体而言,该模块整合了ResNet-50 [28]和VIT-B-16 [20] 骨干,具有不同的微调策略. 虽然ViT模型已完全微调,但ResNet的变体则逐步调整更深层.

blocks.en: Training was performed on a mixed dataset of 162 162 k real images from MS-COCO [ 39 ] and 209 209 k synthetic images from the AIText2Image dataset [ 60 ] that has been generated with Stable Diffusion XL [ 59 ] , DALL-E 2 [ 57 ] and Midjourney 5 [ 46 ] . Additional augmentations such as JPEG compression and common image filters were applied to improve robustness.
blocks.zh: 对MS-COCO[39]和AIText2Image数据集209 K合成图像的162 162 k真实图像的混合数据集进行了培训,这些图像是通过稳定扩散XL[59]、DALL-E 2[57]和Midjourney 5[46]生成的。 还应用了JPEG压缩和通用图像滤波器等额外的增强功能来提高强度.

blocks.en: Table 1 summarizes the performance across evaluation datasets. The results show strong generalization across multiple generators unseen during training, including diffusion-based models such as FLUX, Firefly, and DALL-E 3.
blocks.zh: 表1汇总了各评价数据集的业绩。 结果显示,在培训期间未见的多个发电机中,包括FLUX、萤火虫和DALL-E 3等基于扩散的模型,都得到了有力的概括。

blocks.en: Table 1 : F1-score (%) comparison of AI-generated image detectors on evaluation datasets. Best results per dataset are highlighted in bold. For each dataset, the image type is reported ( R for real and F for fake).
blocks.zh: 表1:评价数据集上AI生成的图像探测器的F1-分数(%)比较. 每个数据集的最佳结果用黑体突出。 对于每个数据集,都报告图像类型(R为真,F为假).

blocks.en: A distinguishing feature of this module is its support for explainability. The integrated XAI methods generate heatmaps that highlight image regions contributing most strongly to the classification decision. To further improve interpretability, these heatmaps are combined with object detection, allowing users to localize and identify objects that contain the most prominent AI-generation artifacts (see Fig. 2 , Explanation section). This supports human analysts in understanding not only the prediction itself, but also the visual evidence behind it.
blocks.zh: 本单元的一个显著特点是支持可解释性。 综合的XAI方法生成热图,突出图像区域对分类决定的贡献最大. 为了进一步提高可解释性,这些热图与对象检测结合,使用户能够定位和识别包含最突出的AI代文物的物体(见图2,解释部分). 这支持人类分析家不仅理解预测本身,而且理解其背后的视觉证据.

blocks.en: 4.2 Image Forgery Detection and Localization
blocks.zh: 4.2 图像伪造检测和本地化

blocks.en: The Image Forgery Detection and Localization (IFDL) module is the primary image-forensic component of MIP and complements the AI-generated image detector by targeting classical image editing operations. In contrast to deepfake detectors, which mainly focus on synthetic faces or videos, IFDL addresses manipulations such as splicing, copy-move, inpainting, object removal, and local content replacement. These manipulations remain highly relevant in real-world misinformation and fraud scenarios [ 27 ] .
blocks.zh: 图像伪造检测与本地化(IFDL)模块是MIP的主要图像法成份,并通过瞄准古典图像编辑操作来补充AI生成的图像检测器. 与主要关注合成面部或视频的深假探测器形成对比的是,IFDL处理的操纵方式有:斯皮克,复制移动,印花,物体清除,以及本地内容替换等. 这些操纵行为在现实世界的错误信息和欺诈情景中仍然具有高度的相关性[27]。

blocks.en: Traditional forensic methods rely on handcrafted traces such as JPEG artifacts, sensor noise inconsistencies, or duplicated textures. While often interpretable, their robustness decreases under strong post-processing or recompression. Recent work therefore increasingly relies on deep learning models that learn manipulation traces directly from data [ 51 ] .
blocks.zh: 传统的法医方法依赖于手制的痕迹,如JPEG文物,感官噪声不一致,或者重复的纹理. 虽然它们往往可以解释,但是在强有力的后处理或再压缩下它们的强性会降低。 因此,最近的工作越来越依赖从数据中直接吸取操纵痕迹的深入学习模式[51].

blocks.en: Within MIP, we integrate a hybrid U-Net–based convolutional network for joint manipulation detection and localization. The model employs a ConvNeXtV2-Base encoder pretrained on ImageNet and a U-Net–style decoder to generate high-resolution segmentation masks. In addition to pixel-level localization, a classification head predicts a global authenticity score, enabling multi-task learning of both detection and localization.
blocks.zh: 在MIP内部,我们整合了一个基于U-Net的混合演化网络,用于联合操纵检测和本地化. 该模型使用在ImageNet上预先训练的ConvNEXtV2-Base编码器和U-Net型解码器,以生成高分辨率分解口罩. 除了像素级本地化外,一个分类头还预测一个全球真伪分数,从而能够同时对检测和本地化进行多任务学习.

blocks.en: Training was performed on a mixture of authentic images from MS COCO [ 39 ] and manipulated samples from DF2023 [ 25 ] and MIML [ 62 ] , with standard augmentation to improve robustness. The model jointly learns to (i) classify images as authentic or manipulated and (ii) localize suspicious regions.
blocks.zh: 对MS COCO[39]和DF2023[25]和MIML[62]的被操纵样品进行了混合真实图像的培训,并进行了标准增强,以提高强度。 该模型共同学习:(一) 将图像归类为真实或被操纵,(二) 将可疑区域定位。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Example output of the IFDL module. The manipulated input image (left) is assigned a high manipulation probability, while the predicted localization mask (right) highlights the tampered region.
blocks.zh: 图5:IFDL模块的示例输出. 被操纵的输入图像(左)被分配到高操纵概率,而预测的本地化面具(右)则突出被篡改的区域.

blocks.en: Benchmark evaluation in Table 2 shows that the proposed model consistently outperforms previous state-of-the-art approaches across multiple forensic datasets, particularly when using test-time augmentation. This demonstrates strong generalization across diverse manipulation types and acquisition conditions.
blocks.zh: 表2中的基准评价表明,拟议模型在多个法证数据集方面,特别是在使用试验时间增强时,一贯比以往最先进的方法要好。 这表明,各种操纵类型和获取条件都非常普遍。

blocks.en: Table 2 : Comparison of state-of-the-art approaches and our proposed IFDL-Model in default mode respectively averaging over the results of the augmented (horizontally/vertically mirrored, rotated) input image. Highest values are highlighted in bold.
blocks.zh: 表2:最新方法与我们提议的IFDL-模型在默认模式下的比较,分别平均于增强(横向/纵向反射、旋转)输入图像的结果。 最高值以粗体显示。

blocks.en: Within MIP, the IFDL module returns both a manipulation confidence score and a localization mask, enabling transparent and human-interpretable forensic analysis (see Fig. 5 for an example). This complements the AI-generated image detector by capturing manipulations applied to otherwise authentic photographs. Combining both signals broadens the range of detectable manipulations and improves robustness in practical forensic workflows.
blocks.zh: 在MIP中,IFDL模块既返回了操纵置信分数,又返回了本地化面具,从而能够进行透明和人可解释的法证分析(例如见图5)。 这对AI生成的图像探测器起到补充作用,它捕捉了适用于其他真实照片的操纵. 将两种信号结合起来,可以扩大可探测操纵的范围,提高实用法证工作流程的稳健性.

blocks.en: Future work will focus on improving robustness against unseen editing tools, strong compression, and adversarial post-processing, as well as integrating forensic evidence with metadata and cross-modal reasoning.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作将侧重于利用不见的编辑工具改进稳健性、强压缩和对抗性后处理,以及将法证证据与元数据和跨模式推理相结合。

blocks.en: 4.3 Face Morphing Detection
blocks.zh: 4.3 面部粉碎检测

blocks.en: Face morphing combines the facial characteristics of two or more individuals into a single synthetic portrait. While originally developed for entertainment purposes, face morphing has become a serious security concern because morphed passport images can deceive face recognition systems and allow multiple individuals to authenticate against the same identity document [ 23 ] . This attack scenario, known as a face morphing attack , represents an important threat for border control, identity verification, and biometric security systems [ 3 ] .
blocks.zh: 面部形态将两个或两个以上个体的面部特征结合为单一的合成肖像. 虽然最初是为娱乐目的开发的,但脸部变形已经成为一个严重的安全问题,因为变形护照图像可以欺骗面部识别系统,允许多个个人对同一身份证件进行认证[23]. 这种攻击情景被称为脸部变形攻击,是对边境管制、身份核查和生物鉴别安全系统的重要威胁。

blocks.en: Recent morphing attack detection methods increasingly rely on deep learning, replacing handcrafted features with discriminative feature extractors pretrained on face recognition tasks. Within MIP, the deployed morphing attack detector is based on ArcFace [ 16 ] with a ResNet-100 backbone. ArcFace learns highly discriminative facial embeddings by enforcing angular separation between identities, which makes it particularly suitable for detecting morphed images that contain blended identity information.
blocks.zh: 近期的变形攻击探测方法越来越依赖深层学习,用歧视性特征提取器取代手动特征,在面部识别任务上预先训练. 在MIP中,部署的形态攻击探测器以ArcFace [16]为基础,具有ResNet-100主干线. ArcFace通过在身份之间强制进行角位分离来学习高度歧视性的面部嵌入,这使得它特别适合检测包含混合身份信息的形态图像.

blocks.en: For training, we curated a diverse morphing dataset from multiple passport-like face datasets and generated morphs using both classical landmark-based and recent deep learning–based morphing methods. This setup provides broad variability in acquisition conditions and morph generation techniques, improving generalization to unseen attacks.
blocks.zh: 在训练方面,我们用多种类似护照的面部数据集对多种形态数据集进行了整理,并采用了古典的地标式和最近的深层学习——基于形态方法。 这种设置在获取条件和形态生成技术方面提供了广泛的变异性,提高了通俗化到看不见的攻击.

blocks.en: The model was fine-tuned for binary classification (bona fide vs. morphed) while preserving the discriminative facial representations learned during large-scale face recognition pretraining.
blocks.zh: 该模型进行了微调,用于二进制分类(bonafine vs. morphed),同时保留了在大规模面部识别前训练中吸取的歧视性面部表情.

blocks.en: Table 3 : Equal Error Rate (EER %) obtained by the evaluated methods on the different morph generation techniques. From left to right the generation methods are: DiffMorpher, Greedy-DiM, MipGAN-II, OpenCV, StyleGAN2 and UTW.
blocks.zh: 表3:通过不同形态生成技术评估的方法获得的相同误差率(ER%)。 从左到右的生成方法是:DiffMorpher,Greedy-DIM,MipGAN-II,OpenCV,StyleGAN2和UTW.

blocks.en: Table 3 summarizes the evaluation results. The ArcFace-based detector achieves the lowest average Equal Error Rate (EER) of 3.58% across all evaluated morph generation methods, outperforming recent morphing attack detectors and demonstrating strong robustness against both classical and learning-based morphs.
blocks.zh: 表3汇总了评价结果。 基于ArcFace的探测器在所有被评价的形态生成方法中都实现了最低平均等误率(EER)为3.58%,比最近的形态攻击探测器表现优于古典和基于学习的形态显示强健.

blocks.en: Within MIP, the Face Morphing Detection module accepts portrait images and returns a morphing probability through the standardized interface. This allows seamless integration with the remaining visual forensic modules, enabling comprehensive authenticity assessment of facial images and identity documents.
blocks.zh: 在MIP内部,Face翻印检测模块接受肖像图像,并通过标准化接口返回一个形态概率. 这样就可以与其余的视觉法医模块进行无缝整合,从而能够对面部图像和身份证件进行全面的真实性评估。

blocks.en: Future work will focus on improving robustness against emerging diffusion-based morphing techniques, which increasingly reduce visible blending artifacts and pose new challenges for forensic analysis.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作将侧重于提高强力,以对付新出现的基于扩散的形态技术,这些技术日益减少可见的混合文物,并对法证分析构成新的挑战。

blocks.en: 4.4 Face Swap Detection in Videos
blocks.zh: 4.4 视频中的面对面交换检测

blocks.en: Face swap is a manipulation technique that transfers the face of a source person onto a target person in images or videos. When performed frame-wise using deep learning models, the resulting manipulated videos are commonly referred to as deepfakes . The most common manipulation categories include face swap, face reenactment, lip-sync, and full face synthesis.
blocks.zh: 面部互换(face switch)是一种在图像或视频中将源人物的面孔转移到目标人物上的操纵技术. 当使用深层学习模型进行帧操作时,所产生的被操纵的视频通常被称为深层假象。 最常见的操控类别包括面质互换,面质重现,唇形合成,以及面质全合成.

blocks.en: The deepfake video module in MIP focuses on detecting face swap and face reenactment manipulations. Given an input video, the system analyzes each detected face across sampled frames and assigns a manipulation score. The output is a per-person timeline of confidence values, enabling both frame-level and video-level forensic inspection.
blocks.zh: MIP中的深假视频模块侧重于检测面值互换和面值重现操纵. 根据输入录影带,系统对每个被检测到的面孔进行跨样本帧分析,并分配一个操纵分数. 产出是每人信任值的时间表,能够进行帧和视频一级的法证检查。

blocks.en: Rather than proposing a new detector, we integrate 19 state-of-the-art deepfake detection methods into a unified benchmark framework following DeepFakeBench [ 84 ] . This allows direct comparison under identical preprocessing and inference conditions. For evaluation, we curated a benchmark of 1000 videos (50 real and 50 fake from each of 10 datasets), enabling cross-dataset performance analysis.
blocks.zh: 我们没有提议新的探测器,而是将19种最先进的深假探测方法纳入DeepFake Bench之后的统一基准框架[84]. 这样可以在相同的预处理和推论条件下直接比较. 为了评价,我们整理了1 000个视频的基准(10个数据集各50个真实视频和50个假视频),以便能够进行跨数据集性能分析。

blocks.en: Table 4 : Deepfake detection methods available on the Media-Intelligence-Platform. Performance on benchmark dataset, sorted by descending video AUC.
blocks.zh: 表4:媒体-信息-平台上现有的深假检测方法. 基准数据集的性能,通过降级视频AUC排序.

blocks.en: The benchmark results (Table 4 ) show that the strongest detectors are based on large pretrained vision backbones such as CLIP and hybrid CNN–Transformer architectures. The best-performing method, EFFORT, achieves a video AUC of 0.928 , followed by Selimsef FbF (0.917) and GenConvViT (0.908).
blocks.zh: 基准结果(表4)显示,最强的探测器是基于CLIP和混合的CNN-Transformer架构等经过预先训练的大型视觉骨干. 最佳表现方法EFFORT实现视频AUC为0.928,之后是Selimsef FbF(0.917)和GenConvViT(0.908).

blocks.en: Our analysis revealed three important findings.
blocks.zh: 我们的分析揭示了三项重要结论。

blocks.en: All detectors depend on accurate face detection and tracking. Weak preprocessing pipelines frequently cause missed faces, incorrect identity assignment, or unstable tracking, significantly degrading detection performance. By replacing the preprocessing stage with a unified GPU-accelerated pipeline, we improved runtime by up to 100 × 100\times for some detectors while increasing robustness across all integrated methods.
blocks.zh: 所有探测器都依赖于准确的面部检测和跟踪. 预处理管道薄弱,往往造成面部缺失,身份分配不正确,或跟踪不稳,明显降低检测性能. 通过用统一的GPU加速管取代预处理阶段,我们改进了运行时间,一些探测器的运行时间可达100×100\时,同时提高所有综合方法的强度.

blocks.en: Cross-dataset generalization remains a major challenge. As shown in [ 19 ] , many detectors implicitly learn facial identities instead of manipulation artifacts, causing strong in-dataset performance but poor transferability. Identity-disjoint train/test splits are therefore essential for reliable evaluation.
blocks.zh: 跨数据集的概括仍然是一大挑战。 如[19]所示,许多探测器隐含地学习面部特征,而不是操纵文物,导致强大的数据集性能,但可转移性差. 因此,对可靠的评价来说,识别-脱节列车/测试分拆至关重要。

blocks.en: The best-performing methods consistently rely on large pretrained vision models and lightweight fine-tuning strategies such as LoRA, SVD-based adaptation, or partial layer unfreezing. These approaches preserve general visual representations while adapting to forensic artifacts.
blocks.zh: 最佳的操作方法始终依赖于经过预先训练的大型视觉模型和轻量级微调策略,如LORA,基于SVD的适应,或者部分层解冻. 这些方法在适应法医文物的同时保留了一般的视觉表现.

blocks.en: Figure 6 : For each video and each detector result the report will display a bar chart for each person with the predicted faceswap detection confidence per frame or sequence.
blocks.zh: 图6:每段视频和每个探测器的结果,报告将显示每个人的条形图,并显示每个帧或序列的预测面图检测信心。

blocks.en: Within MIP, users can select any of the 19 integrated detectors for video analysis. For each tracked individual, the system visualizes frame-wise manipulation scores and aggregated video-level predictions (Fig. 6 ), enabling direct comparison of detector behavior and supporting interpretable forensic analysis.
blocks.zh: 在MIP内部,用户可以选择19个综合探测器中的任何一台进行视频分析. 对于每一个被跟踪的个人,系统可视化了帧式操纵分数和汇总的视频水平预测(图6),从而可以直接比较探测器行为并支持可解释的法医学分析.

blocks.en: Future work will extend this framework toward emerging multimodal diffusion-based video generation models, where the forensic task remains the same: determining whether facial content originates from authentic recordings or synthetic generation.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作将扩展这一框架,使之包括新出现的基于多式联运的视频生成模型,其中法医任务保持不变:确定面部内容是来自真实录音还是合成生成。

blocks.en: 5 Audio Deepfake Detection
blocks.zh: 5 音频深假检测

blocks.en: Audio deepfake detection has become increasingly important with the rapid progress of neural speech synthesis and voice cloning models. Synthetic speech can be used for impersonation, fraud, and disinformation, making robust forensic detection essential.
blocks.zh: 随着神经语音合成和语音克隆模型的快速发展,音频深假探测变得越来越重要. 合成语言可用于假冒、欺诈和造谣,使有力的法证侦查至关重要。

blocks.en: The Media Intelligence Platform provides a dedicated Deepfake Speech Detection (DSD) module for analyzing manipulated speech recordings. Following recent trends in the literature, the module is based on a fine-tuned pre-trained audio foundation model.
blocks.zh: 媒体情报 平台提供一个专门的Deepfake语音检测模块(DSD),用于分析被操纵的语音录音. 遵循近代文献发展趋势,该单元采用精细预训音频基础模型.

blocks.en: The DSD module uses the pretrained WavLM backbone [ 8 ] to extract feature embeddings from 4-second audio segments. Training follows a three-stage optimization strategy (see Fig. 7 ). First, multiple supervisory objectives are applied jointly, including A-Softmax loss for multi-class spoof classification, Contrastive Loss to separate bona fide and spoofed embeddings, and Center Loss to compact bona fide embeddings. In the second stage, the model is fine-tuned for binary classification. In the final stage, the backbone is frozen and bona fide embeddings are used to estimate a Mahalanobis distribution, enabling anomaly-based inference for unseen spoofing attacks.
blocks.zh: DSD模块使用预训的WavLM主干线[8]从4秒音频段提取特性嵌入. 培训遵循三阶段优化战略(见图7)。 首先,多个监督目标被共同应用,包括多类嵌入物分类的A-Softmax损失、分离善意嵌入物的对比性损失和紧凑善意嵌入物的中心损失。 在第二阶段,该模型为二进制分类进行了微调. 在最后阶段,骨干被冻结,并使用善意嵌入来估计马哈拉诺比斯的分布,从而能够对隐形的偷袭进行异常推断。

blocks.en: The model was trained on ASVspoof 2019 (LA) [ 77 ] , ASVspoof 2021 (LA & DF) [ 81 ] , and ASVspoof5 [ 74 ] . Evaluation was performed on three unseen datasets: In-The-Wild [ 50 ] , ASVspoof5 Evaluation Subset [ 74 ] , and FakeAVCeleb [ 33 ] , allowing assessment of cross-dataset generalization.
blocks.zh: 该型号曾接受过2019年ASVspoof(LA)[77],2021年ASVspoof(LA & DF)[81],以及ASVspoof5[74]的培训. 在三个隐形数据集上进行了评价:In-The-Wild [50],ASVspoof5评价子集 [74],和FakeAVCeleb [33],从而可以评估跨数据集的概括.

blocks.en: Table 5 : Cross-dataset performance of the DSD module.
blocks.zh: 表5:DSD模块的跨数据集性能.

blocks.en: The results demonstrate strong generalization across unseen datasets, indicating robustness against a wide range of synthetic speech generation methods.
blocks.zh: 结果表明,对各种无形数据集的强烈概括,表明与各种合成语音生成方法相对应的强性。

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Overview of the Deepfake Speech Detection (DSD) pipeline. The model uses a three-stage training strategy based on feature extraction, discriminative embedding learning, and Mahalanobis-based inference.
blocks.zh: 图7:深假语音检测(DSD)管道概况. 该模式采用基于特征提取,歧视性嵌入式学习和马哈拉诺比斯推论的三阶段培训策略.

blocks.en: Within MIP, the DSD module accepts uploaded speech recordings and returns segment-wise and recording-level authenticity predictions. This enables forensic inspection of manipulated speech and complements the platform’s visual and textual analysis modules for multimodal media verification.
blocks.zh: 在MIP中,DSD模块接受上传的语音录音,并按片段返回和录制层的真实性预测. 这有助于对被操纵的言论进行法证检查,并补充该平台的视觉和文字分析模块,用于多式联运媒体核查。

blocks.en: 6 Text Analysis Modules
blocks.zh: 6 文本分析模块

blocks.en: Text-based disinformation detection cannot usually be reduced to a simple binary true/false classification problem. Instead, misleading content often manifests through multiple linguistic, semantic, stylistic, and ideological signals. To address this, MIP integrates a modular text analysis framework that combines several specialized classifiers for detecting harmful or manipulative communication patterns.
blocks.zh: 基于文字的假象检测通常不能简化为简单的二进制真象/假象分类问题. 相反,误导性的内容往往通过多种语言,语义,语义和意识形态的信号表现出来. 为了解决这个问题,MIP整合了一个模块化文本分析框架,将几个专门分类器结合起来,用于检测有害或操纵性通信模式.

blocks.en: The framework is built around transformer-based language models, primarily XLM-RoBERTa (XLM-R) [ 11 ] , fine-tuned for a range of classification tasks on German news and social media datasets. The implemented modules cover hate speech, toxicity, sexism, extremism, offensive language, sentiment, reporting style, and writing style detection.
blocks.zh: 框架围绕基于变压器的语言模型构建,主要是XLM-RoBERTa(XLM-R)[11],为德国新闻和社交媒体数据集的一系列分类任务进行了微调. 执行的单元包括仇恨言论、毒性、性别歧视、极端主义、攻击性语言、情绪、报告风格和写作风格检测。

blocks.en: To improve interpretability and robustness, transformer embeddings can be combined with handcrafted linguistic features such as punctuation patterns, sentiment scores, stylistic indicators, and structural text properties. These features complement contextual embeddings by capturing rhetorical and surface-level signals relevant to manipulative communication.
blocks.zh: 为了提高可解释性和稳健性,变压器嵌入可以与手动语言特征结合,如振动模式,情绪分数,结构指标,结构文本属性等. 这些特征通过捕捉与操纵性通信有关的言辞和表面信号来补充背景嵌入。

blocks.en: Experimental results show that transformer-based models perform strongly on standard classification tasks, while fusion architectures improve robustness in multilabel and long-document settings.
blocks.zh: 实验结果显示,基于变压器的模型在标准分类任务上表现强劲,而聚变结构则在多标签和长文件设置中提高稳健性.

blocks.en: Rather than directly classifying content as “fake” or “real”, the framework focuses on identifying indicators commonly associated with disinformation and manipulation. These include propaganda framing, clickbait, sensationalism, polarization, subjective writing, toxicity, and ideological extremism. Such signals often become more informative when analyzed jointly rather than in isolation.
blocks.zh: 该框架没有直接将内容归类为“虚假”或“真实”,而是侧重于确定通常与虚假和操纵有关的指标。 其中包括宣传陷害、点击、耸人听闻、两极分化、主观写作、毒性和意识形态极端主义。 在联合分析而不是孤立分析时,这种信号往往会更加翔实。

blocks.en:
Classifier outputs are aggregated into four reliability levels ( Highly Questionable , Questionable , Slightly Questionable , Reliable ) using weighted rules based on indicator severity and co-occurrence, providing an interpretable overall assessment.
This aggregation combines detector outputs using weighted rules based on the severity and co-occurrence of individual indicators, allowing a more transparent and explainable reliability assessment.
blocks.zh:
采用基于指标严重程度和同时发生的加权规则,将分类产出汇总为四个可靠性等级(高度可质疑、可质疑、略可质疑、可靠),提供可解释的总体评估。
这种汇总结合了探测器的输出,采用基于单个指标的严重性和共同发生率的加权规则,从而可以进行更透明和更可解释的可靠性评估。

blocks.en: Within MIP, users can run individual text classifiers independently or combine them into a unified disinformation analysis pipeline. This modular setup supports applications such as content moderation, propaganda analysis, journalism support, and credibility assessment, extending the platform beyond multimedia forensics toward broader multimodal media intelligence.
blocks.zh: 在MIP内部,用户可以独立运行单个文本分类器,或者将它们合并为统一的虚假分析管道. 这种模块化设置支持诸如内容节制、宣传分析、新闻支持和可信度评估等应用,将平台范围从多媒体法医学扩展到更广泛的多模式媒体智能。

blocks.en: 7 Publicly Available Demonstrator
blocks.zh: 7 公开演示

blocks.en: To support reproducibility and enable exploration of the Media Intelligence Platform (MIP), we provide a publicly accessible demonstration instance at https://media-intelligence.ait.ac.at/ .
blocks.zh: 为了支持可复制性并促成对媒体情报平台的探索,我们在https://media-intelligence.ait.ac.at/上提供了一个可公开查阅的演示实例。 。 。 。

blocks.en:
The demonstrator provides access to multimodal analysis modules for images, videos, audio, and text, including AI-generated image detection, image manipulation localization, face morphing detection, deepfake video and audio detection, hate speech detection, and text toxicity detection.
Readers can evaluate these modules using the demo account ( mip-demo / spot_the_fakes2026 ).
blocks.zh:
演示人提供图像,视频,音频和文本的多式联运分析模块,包括AI生成的图像检测,图像操纵本地化,面部形态检测,深假视频和音频检测,仇恨言论检测,文本毒性检测.
读者可以使用演示账号(mip-demo / spot_the_fakes2026)来评价这些模块.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we presented the Media Intelligence Platform (MIP), a unified and modular framework for multimodal media forensics. Unlike most existing approaches that focus on a single manipulation type or modality, MIP integrates state-of-the-art analysis modules for AI-generated images, image forgery localization, face morphing detection, deepfake video and audio detection, and text-based content analysis within a common microservice-based architecture.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了媒体情报平台(MIP),这是一个统一和模块化的多媒体法证框架. 与大多数注重单一操控类型或模式的现有方法不同,MIP整合了AI生成的图像的最先进的分析模块,图像伪造本地化,面部形态检测,深假视频和音频检测,以及基于共同微服务架构的文本内容分析.

blocks.en:
The proposed design enables scalable deployment, standardized access through REST APIs, and flexible integration of heterogeneous forensic models. By combining multiple complementary analysis modules, MIP reduces tool fragmentation and supports practical forensic workflows involving images, videos, audio, and text.
Experimental evaluations across representative benchmark datasets demonstrate that the integrated modules achieve strong performance across their respective tasks. The public demonstrator further provides researchers and practitioners with direct access to the platform for experimentation and validation.
blocks.zh:
拟议的设计能够使部署具有可扩展性,通过REST API实现标准化准入,并灵活整合各种法证模型。 MIP通过结合多个互补分析模块,减少工具破碎,并支持涉及图像,视频,音频,文本的实用法证工作流程.
具有代表性的基准数据集的实验性评价表明,综合模块在各自任务中取得了良好的业绩。 公共演示进一步为研究人员和从业人员提供了直接进入实验和验证平台的机会.

blocks.en: Future work will focus on extending the platform to emerging manipulation techniques, improving robustness against unseen generative models, and strengthening multimodal reasoning across heterogeneous forensic evidence.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作将侧重于将该平台扩大到新兴的操纵技术,提高抵御未见遗传模型的稳健性,加强跨不同法医证据的多式联运推理。
